title: Project Serpo exchange program

tellings.quote: So the Serpo thing was planet Serpo sent a bunch of aliens here and we sent a bunch of humans to their star system in an exchange in the 1970s sometime.

plain: Under a story called Project Serpo, aliens from a planet named Serpo are said to have sent some of their own to Earth in the 1970s, while humans were sent to their star system in an exchange. The researcher Greg Bishop summarises it, tying it to a man named Rick Doty and to a set of leaked papers known as the Serpo leak, which if true would mean a secret swap of people between two worlds.
